privacy_contract: No cookies are set. No fingerprinting, no cross-site or cross-session identifiers, no IP-based storobes.

Events queue in the visitor's browser (localStorage key shopnow_events_v1, capped at 500) and POST only to the configured self-hosted endpoint (window.SHOPNOW_CONFIG.analyticsEndpoint). Endpoint unset = nothing leaves the browser.
No personal data fields exist in any event schema. Payloads contain page paths, event names, product IDs, and host names only.
The visitor can see and export their own queue from dashboard/index.html.

events.name: page_view
events.purpose: Traffic baseline for every surface; the denominator for all click rates.

events.name: outbound_product_click
events.when: Any click on an anchor carrying data-product-intent (every product CTA).
events.purpose: The outbound-click counter. Feeds ledger clicks only after corroborated by authorized first-party reports (S03 qualifying-purchase chain).

events.name: guide_engaged
events.when: Reader scrolls past 75% of a guide page (fired once per page load).
events.purpose: Distinguishes arrived-and-read from bounced traffic when picking the next topic.

events.name: reader_capture_submitted
events.when: Reader submits the capture form. No address is stored or sent until an email provider decision (SG-11).
events.purpose: Interest signal for reader capture (SG-30 line of the brief).

events.name: dashboard_event_exported
events.when: A maintainer exports the event queue from the dashboard.
events.purpose: Provenance trail for manual ledger entries: every ledger row added from an export should cite the export in provenance_note.
